subject: update using model object from environment, not lavaan object

messages.author: bf8f36df5af5dacc
messages.subject: update using model object from environment, not lavaan object
parts:
Hello all,

I ran into an interesting error when running update on lavaan output.  I wanted to see if this is something that is considered a bug.  If I run update on a lavaan object and the model used when creating that object is not available in the environment, then the update fails.

Here is a basic example:

library(lavaan)

data(HolzingerSwineford1939)

HSmodel <- paste0("visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3 ",
"textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6 ",
"speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 ")

output1 <- cfa(HSmodel, data = HolzingerSwineford1939, std.lv = TRUE)
rm(HSmodel)
update(output1, std.lv = TRUE, std.ov = TRUE)

> Error in lavaan::lavaan(model = HSmodel, data = HolzingerSwineford1939,  : 
  object 'HSmodel' not found

I can work around this by telling the update function to use the model in output1:

update(output1, output1@Options$model, std.lv = TRUE, std.ov = TRUE)

I am wondering if the update function should automatically point at output1@Options$model rather than looking for HSmodel?

Thank you for your time!

- Ben
